description: Key facts a correct lesson on each Environmental Science topic must state. Every fact was taken from the fetched text of the source page named with it (the quote is checked by `npm run golden:check`). Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions matched against the lesson text after LaTeX backslashes and braces are removed.
subject: environmental-science

facts.claim: An ecosystem links biotic (living) and abiotic (non-living) components

source.quote: the biotic and abiotic components are linked together through nutrient cycles and energy flows

facts.claim: Energy enters through photosynthesis by plants

source.quote: Plants allow energy to enter the system through photosynthesis

facts.claim: A food chain starts with a producer (autotroph)

source.quote: often beginning with an autotroph (such as grass or algae), also called a producer

facts.claim: Energy moves through trophic levels

source.quote: This energy then moves through the trophic levels

facts.claim: Only about 10% of energy passes to the next trophic level

source.quote: on average only about 10% is used at each level to build biomass

facts.claim: Pyramids of energy are always upright

source.quote: Pyramids of energy are normally upright

facts.claim: A hotspot has ≥ 1,500 endemic vascular plant species and has lost most of its habitat

source.quote: it must contain at least 1,500 species of vascular plants (more than 0.5% of the world's total) as endemics

facts.claim: Hotspots are rich in biodiversity and threatened by humans

source.quote: a biogeographic region with significant levels of biodiversity that is threatened by human habitation

facts.claim: 17 megadiverse countries (identified by Conservation International)

source.quote: Conservation International identified 17 megadiverse countries in 1998

facts.claim: The main criterion is endemism

source.quote: The main criterion for megadiverse countries is endemism at the level of species, genera and families

facts.claim: Deforestation: removal of forest and conversion of the land to non-forest use

source.quote: the removal and destruction of a forest or stand of trees from land that is then converted to non-forest use

facts.claim: Agriculture is the main direct cause

source.quote: By far, the direct cause of most deforestation is agriculture

facts.claim: Desertification: fertile land degrades into desert (natural + human causes)

source.quote: gradual land degradation of fertile land into arid desert due to a combination of natural processes and human activities

facts.claim: CFCs and halons cause ozone depletion

source.quote: chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs), HCFCs, halons

facts.claim: The Montreal Protocol (1987) banned CFCs

source.quote: These concerns led to the adoption of the Montreal Protocol in 1987

facts.claim: Acid rain comes from SO₂ and NOₓ forming sulfuric and nitric acids

source.quote: Acid rain is caused by emissions of sulfur dioxide and nitrogen oxide, which react with the water molecules in the atmosphere to produce sulfuric and nitric acids

facts.claim: Acid rain has a low pH (about 4–5)

source.quote: acid rain has a pH level lower than this and ranges from 4–5 on average

facts.claim: Pollutants are gases (ozone, NOₓ) or particles (soot, dust)

source.quote: Pollutants can be gases, like ozone or nitrogen oxides, or small particles like soot and dust

facts.claim: Particulate matter is the deadliest pollutant

source.quote: Particulate matter is the most deadly, both for indoor and outdoor air pollution

facts.claim: Rainwater harvesting: collect and store rain instead of letting it run off

source.quote: Rainwater harvesting (RWH) is the collection and storage of rainwater, rather than allowing it to run off

facts.claim: Rooftop water is led to tanks or pits to recharge ground water

source.quote: so that it seeps down and restores the ground water

facts.claim: Ex-situ: protecting a species outside its natural habitat

source.quote: the process of protecting an endangered species, variety, or breed of plant or animal outside its natural habitat

facts.claim: Zoos, botanical gardens and aquariums

source.quote: Botanical gardens, zoos, and aquariums are the most conventional sites for ex situ conservation

facts.claim: The Environment Protection Act, 1986 followed the Bhopal gas tragedy

source.quote: The Act is widely considered to have been a response to the Bhopal gas leak

facts.claim: It gives the central government power to protect the environment

source.quote: Section one gives the central government the power to protect and improve the environment
